findings.what:
v3 FINAL_REPORT (g) risk 2: 'a new stage can fail silently on private only'. An exception sends the dataset to fallback_output_graph, public cannot see it, and the mitigation was fail-soft stages plus F2 on another stack. The risk was assessed before the four components added since 25 Sep that now sit in every V_pub candidate: CI (coordinject), SEC n2a, K and DIS 2.25.
WHAT CHANGED: I audited the code of the night and morning files.
(1) CI is a post-CSV step. Each worker catches failures per video ('COORDINJECT_WORKER FAILED'), and that video keeps its rows. The deadline skip leaves the rest of that shard's rows as they were. The whole step is wrapped in try/except, so on any failure the CSV is untouched. The rewrite is atomic with a line-count check. A private-only CI failure therefore leaves exactly the non-CI twin's rows for the affected videos.
(2) SEC loads the weights once and raises on a sha256 mismatch. Its only fallback message, 'FALLING BACK TO SINGLE-SEED', is global. Any SEC failure is an ERROR or shows on public; there is no per-dataset path.
(3) K and DIS are env knobs in existing code paths, with no new per-dataset code.
(4) DIVINS fails soft per dataset (no insertion). #37 and exp75 carry insertion too, so they share this.
(5) 'REPAIR FAILED' -> fallback_output_graph is x138-native and identical in every finals candidate, #37 included.
The 6 CI dummies (exp75, 79a, 87a, 89r, 89l, 83c) show 0 COORDINJECT_WORKER FAILED, 0 REPAIR FAILED and 0 DIVINS FAILED/SKIPPED; the SUMMARY is 4/4 videos with 0.913-0.917 of nodes replaced. CI time per video scales with detections: 71-80 s at 9.4k detections, 225-238 s at 80.6k.
NEW VERDICT: UPHELD in form, BOUNDED in size. The private-only silent-failure gap between a CI V_pub and its non-CI twin is at most CI's own gain on the affected videos (<= ~+0.001, the public CI step). SEC, K and DIS add no private-only failure path. The catastrophic class (REPAIR FAILED fallback) is common to every candidate, so no finals pair hedges it. The partner does not need to buy 'failure insurance'; its role stays a lever hedge.

findings.what:
Four v3 claims about deadline guards:
- s_merge: 'x138 verbatim is a safe finals base' was OVERTURNED because 'the guard (REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000, sorted dataset order) can still degrade alphabetically late private datasets'.
- v3 (f): 'F2 = exp52 ... alone insures the world where the timer fired on private'.
- v3 (g) risk 13: the 0.953 block may split on private because copies could hit the timer differently.
- v_kaggle-intel_runtime-guard-audit_value: 'public movies almost surely not degraded', which leaves private as the possible victim.
WHAT CHANGED:
(1) One hidden run produces both boards, and every deadline is wall-clock from KERNEL_START_TS: REPAIR 34,200 s, DIVINS 28,800 s = 8.0 h kernel time, CI 37,800 s.
(2) The ledger now has L for every COMPLETE candidate: #37 (7.36, 7.54] h, #38 (6.69, 6.87], exp70g (7.49, 7.67], exp85a (7.01, 7.19], exp79a (9.27, 9.45], exp87a (9.30, 9.48]. The tightest deadline is DIVINS at 8.0 h (for CI files, 8.0 h plus the CI stage dL 1.6-2.2 h, i.e. the 10.2 h mark). Every L_hi is below it, so no deadline fired on ANY dataset, public or private.
(3) Order: the repair loop walks sorted geffs, test_stems are sorted, and the CI shards take stems[i::2] of that sorted list. Stems are '<embryo prefix>_<hash>' (743006: prefix = embryo). Any tail skip therefore hits the last-named embryo block first. 743006 (unverified) says 'first private, second public'. If that is the name order, the tail is public, and a skip would show on public before private.
NEW VERDICT: The 'timer fired on private' world is VOID for all 6 COMPLETE finals candidates. v3's runtime-insurance reason for F2 does not tell any pair apart, so partner choice rests on lever hedging only (as the card already does). GAP RULE v2 is UPHELD for the pending reads (exp89r, exp75, exp89l). A '+'/'0u' read with L_hi in (10.2, 10.75] h, flagged UNPROVEN-ins, is conservative for private under the 743006 order. Under the reverse order private loses at most the insertion on the tail clips (<= ~0.0005, PC25-07 bound). Side note on risk 13: x138 copies (L34 <= 6.46 h against its 7.5 h guard) degrade only in a hidden run more than ~16% slower, so the x138 block's private wall is probably intact.
